content: PRF support matrix, mid-2026 (cross-checked against Corbado, Yubico, Chromium/chromestatus, webauthn.wtf sources): Chrome/Edge 147+ supports PRF-on-create on Windows (146 and earlier only supported PRF at get()-time on Windows); macOS 15+/Chrome 132+ via iCloud Keychain has worked longer. Firefox 148+ fully supports PRF w/ Windows Hello for both create and get (147 backported create-time only). Safari 18+/macOS 15 works via iCloud Keychain; Safari on iOS/iPadOS still cannot pass extension data to/from an external roaming authenticator (platform-specific dead end unrelated to authenticator capability). Windows Hello only returns PRF values after the Feb 2026 update (KB5077181, WEBAUTHN_API_VERSION_8) on Windows 11 25H2 -- older builds silently lack PRF with no clean way to distinguish that from 'authenticator doesn't support PRF' client-side. Android: broadly strong support, Google Password Manager passkeys include PRF by default across Chrome/Edge/Samsung Internet; some Android 14 credential providers don't implement hmac_secret. This matches and reconfirms the 2026-07-12 PITFALLS.md snapshot -- no material drift found in the 2 days since.
